lines: Would you want to sit down and take a break in the middle of your shift?
That would mean that your fellow brethren must pick up your slack!
A second of you lounging around means another second that your comrade must toil away in your stead.
Your father has fought against corruption and he shall now rest.
Your mother has given you life and she shall now rest.
This is your duty, and you shall earn your rest soon enough.
Do right by your brothers and sisters. Do right by your people. Do right by your country.
